g.text: 5 V low-side MOSFET drivers for the fan and the buzzer

g.desc: 5 V low-side MOSFET drivers for the fan and the buzzer

path.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;fill-rule:evenodd;

g.text: J206: JST XH, 2 pin. 1 = E5V (fan red), 2 = switched return (fan black).

g.desc: J206: JST XH, 2 pin. 1 = E5V (fan red), 2 = switched return (fan black).

g.text: Fan: Sunon MF40100V1, 5 V, 136 mA. FAN_EN = PB6 (TIM4_CH1): high = fan on, PWM possible.

g.desc: Fan: Sunon MF40100V1, 5 V, 136 mA. FAN_EN = PB6 (TIM4_CH1): high = fan on, PWM possible.

g.text: D203 carries the motor current at switch-off, D201 clamps the 5 V rail.

g.desc: D203 carries the motor current at switch-off, D201 clamps the 5 V rail.

g.text: BZ201: TMB09A05, 5 V active buzzer, about 30 mA. Pin 1 = +.

g.desc: BZ201: TMB09A05, 5 V active buzzer, about 30 mA. Pin 1 = +.

g.text: BUZZER = PB3 (TIM2_CH2, also SWO): high = sound.

g.desc: BUZZER = PB3 (TIM2_CH2, also SWO): high = sound.

g.text: Beep patterns are timed in firmware. D204: flyback diode.

g.desc: Beep patterns are timed in firmware. D204: flyback diode.
